AcquisitionMethod.description:
How a candidate's bytes are obtained. Missing on historical event rows,
 which describe torrent releases before this field existed.

deliveryStatus.description:
NONE | PENDING | SENT | FAILED for the viewing requester, derived from
 the delivery record rather than the consumed delivery intent.

keepLooking.description: True while an automatic retry is scheduled for this failure.

managedByMe.description:
True when this viewer approved the request this acquisition fulfils,
 so an approving adult can manage a child's acquisition.

canAcquire.description: Adults only: permission to add new files to the shared collection.

canDiscover.description: Children only: access to public catalogue browsing and suggestions.

canRequest.description: Whether a child may submit a book for adult approval.

source.description:
`local` answers from the durable catalogue only, without waiting for
 the metadata provider; the full response carries both lists.

authorRefs.description:
Durable author identities for linking; `authors` stays the display
 names for every existing consumer.

availableLanguages.description: Catalogue availability; this is separate from the language of a file.

browserFileId.description: The viewer's last browser EPUB, populated by the book service.

deliveryStatus.description: Latest reader send for this approval, when one has been attempted.

phase.description:
User-facing stage: requested | looking | getting | ready | declined |
 unavailable. Internal acquisition states never leave the server.

missing.description: `cover`, `description` or `language`: books an admin could fix.

user.description: Administrators may browse a child's shelf by id; children stay self-scoped.

CatalogueQuery.description: Catalogue works for an author that the household does not own yet.

avatarPreset.description: Optional bundled profile mark. Null or omitted uses initials.

canAcquire.description: Adults only: allow adding new books to the shared library.

canDiscover.description: Children only: allow public catalogue browsing and suggestions.

canRequest.description: Children only: permits request submission and basic catalogue search.

startingBookIds.description: Children only: owned household books to assign in the creation transaction.

detail.description: Event details are an append-only journal of several event-specific shapes.

languages.description: Complete language set when the provider exposes one.

ratingAverage.description: Ranking signals; missing values simply contribute no bonus.

formatTier.description:
Format preference comes first (EPUB before the PDF fallback), then
 the reader's ordered language preference. Defaulted because candidate
 lists are persisted in events and outlive struct changes.

scope.description: Personal by default; `scope=household` is the explicit escape hatch.

user.description: Administrators may target a child's shelf by id; children stay self-scoped.

scope.description: Admin-only `scope=household`; the default is the caller's own requests.

ProfileMark.description: IDs of the bundled, age-neutral Bokhylle profile marks.

ProfileMarkInput.description: A required nullable field: null restores initials, a bundled ID selects a mark.

anyOf.description: Older journal entries may predate today's candidate fields.

user.description: Administrators may search a child's shelf by id; children stay self-scoped.

provider.description:
Explicit provider choice: only that provider is queried, with no
 hidden fallback. Omitted means the configured Automatic behaviour.

source.description: `local` answers books and authors from the durable catalogue only.

avatarPreset.description: Omitted preserves the mark; null restores initials. Does not remove a photo.

canDiscover.description: Children only: allow public catalogue browsing and suggestions.

canRequest.description: Children only: permits request submission and basic catalogue search.

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie returned by login. Admin and child permissions are enforced by the server.
